description: This file contains the implementation of DefaultDeviceResolver, a class that provides device authentication and key retrieval functionality for a CoAP adapter in the Hono framework. It interacts with the Credentials service to resolve device secrets, handles DTLS pre-shared keys, and manages device identities based on incoming authentication information.

classes.name: DefaultDeviceResolver
classes.description: A class implementing device authentication interfaces for CoAP, resolving device credentials and handling PSK identities.

methods.name: getCandidateKey
methods.description: Retrieves the first candidate secret key from the device credentials.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Provides additional info about the client, resolving device details from credentials service.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Retrieves the pre-shared key for a given identity or server names.

methods.name: getSharedKeyForDevice
methods.description: Asynchronously obtains the shared key for a device based on its credentials.

methods.name: getIdentity
methods.description: Placeholder for retrieving device identity based on socket address; not supported in this implementation.

methods.name: getHandshakeIdentity
methods.description: Creates a tenant-aware device identity based on the provided pre-shared key identity string.
